body:
A NumPy fallback mode has been discussed to be introduced. It would for instance allow users to more easily port their NumPy code to CuPy.

#### Some key points

- Easier to port from NumPy code bases.
- Introduce a mechanism to enable/disable the fallback mode, e.g. to avoid unnoticed performance degradation due to hidden synchronizations and transfers. It could be a flag, function, etc.
title: Should introduce NumPy fallback mode
